# Available Tools

<!-- Code generated by `go generate ./...`. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Edit the tool definitions in pkg/toolsets/**/tools.go and regenerate. -->

Each tool is exposed through the MCP protocol and can be invoked by the Rancher AI agent. Tools are grouped by toolset. Tools marked **Write** modify state and are only registered when the server is not running in read-only mode.

## fleet

| Tool | Access | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `analyzeFleetResources` | Read-only | Analyze Fleet resources and diagnose bundle deployment issues.<br><br>This command collects diagnostic information about Fleet resources including GitRepos,<br>Bundles, BundleDeployments, and related resources. It outputs JSON containing only the<br>fields relevant for troubleshooting, making it easy to identify issues like:<br><br>- Bundles stuck with old commits or forceSyncGeneration<br>- BundleDeployments not applying their target deploymentID<br>- Orphaned secrets with invalid owner references<br>- Resources stuck with deletion timestamps due to finalizers<br>- API server consistency issues (time travel)<br>- Missing or problematic Content resources |
| `getBundle` | Read-only | Get a specific Fleet Bundle by name and workspace. |
| `getGitRepo` | Read-only | Get a specific GitRepo by name and workspace. |
| `listGitRepos` | Read-only | List all GitRepos in a workspace. |

## provisioning

| Tool | Access | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `analyzeCluster` | Read-only | Gets a cluster's complete configuration including provisioning and management clusters, the CAPI cluster, CAPI machines, and machine pool configs.<br>This should be used when a complete overview of the clusters current state and its configuration is required. |
| `analyzeClusterMachines` | Read-only | Gets all Machine related resources for a cluster including Machines, MachineSets, and MachineDeployments.<br>This should be used when a summary or overview of just the existing machine resources is required. |
| `createCustomCluster` | Write | Creates a custom cluster within Rancher.<br>This should only be used when the user wants to create a new custom cluster. Do not use this tool if a user asks to create an imported cluster. |
| `createCustomClusterPlan` | Write | Plans to create a custom cluster within Rancher. It returns the JSON representation of the resource to be created without actually creating it in the cluster. Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation.<br>This should only be used when the user wants to create a new custom cluster. Do not use this tool if a user asks to create an imported cluster. |
| `createImportedCluster` | Write | Creates an imported cluster within Rancher.<br>This should only be used when the user wants to create a new imported cluster. Do not use this tool when the user asks to create a new custom cluster. |
| `createImportedClusterPlan` | Write | Plans to create an imported cluster within Rancher. It returns the JSON representation of the resource to be created without actually creating it in the cluster. Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation.<br>This should only be used when the user wants to create a new imported cluster. Do not use this tool when the user asks to create a new custom cluster. |
| `createK3kCluster` | Write | Create a new K3k cluster in a specific downstream cluster. |
| `createK3kClusterPlan` | Write | Plans to create a new K3k cluster in a specific downstream cluster. It returns the JSON representation of the resource to be created without actually creating it. Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation. |
| `getClusterMachine` | Read-only | Gets a specific machine and its parent MachineSet and MachineDeployment.<br>This should be used when detailed information about a specific machine is required. |
| `listK3kClusters` | Read-only | List K3k virtual clusters deployed across downstream clusters. |
| `listSupportedKubernetesVersions` | Read-only | Returns the currently supported rke2 and k3s versions that can be provisioned.<br>This should only be used when information about the supported rke2 and k3s is needed. This is often required to support provisioning custom and imported clusters. |
| `scaleClusterNodePool` | Write | Changes the size of an existing node pool for an rke2 or k3s cluster.<br>This should be used when the user wants to change the size of an existing node pool for an rke2 or k3s cluster.<br>Pools cannot be scaled to zero nodes, and etcd node pools cannot be scaled below 3 nodes to prevent loss of quorum.<br>The local cluster does not support node pool scaling. |
| `scaleClusterNodePoolPlan` | Write | Plans to change the size of an existing node pool for an rke2 or k3s cluster. It returns the JSON representation of the updated node pool resource without actually applying the change in the cluster.<br>Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation. This should be used when the user wants to change the size of an existing node pool for an rke2 or k3s cluster.<br>Pools cannot be scaled to zero nodes, and etcd node pools cannot be scaled below 3 nodes to prevent loss of quorum.<br>The local cluster does not support node pool scaling. |

## rancher

| Tool | Access | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `createGlobalRole` | Write | Creates a global role in Rancher.<br>Rules grant permissions in the local cluster where Rancher runs.<br>Inherited cluster roles grant the named cluster role templates in every downstream cluster.<br>Use createGlobalRoleBinding to assign the global role to users or groups. |
| `createGlobalRoleBinding` | Write | Assigns a global role to a user or group by creating a global role binding (GRB).<br>Exactly one of user or group must be specified. The user can be a username or user ID.<br>The global role must be specified by name. Use getGlobalRole to find the name from a display name. |
| `createGlobalRoleBindingPlan` | Write | Plans to assign a global role to a user or group. It returns the JSON representation of the global role binding to be created without actually creating it. Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation. |
| `createGlobalRolePlan` | Write | Plans to create a global role in Rancher. It returns the JSON representation of the global role to be created without actually creating it. Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation. |
| `createKubernetesResource` | Write | Creates a resource in a Kubernetes cluster from a complete Kubernetes manifest passed in the 'manifest' field, in YAML or JSON. The namespace must be empty for cluster-wide resources.<br><br>Example of the manifest parameter (YAML):<br>apiVersion: v1<br>kind: ConfigMap<br>metadata:<br>name: my-cm<br>data:<br>key: value |
| `createKubernetesResourcePlan` | Write | Plans to create a resource in a Kubernetes cluster from a complete Kubernetes manifest passed in the 'manifest' field, in YAML or JSON. It returns the JSON representation of the resource to be created without actually creating it in the cluster. Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation. The namespace must be empty for cluster-wide resources. |
| `createProject` | Write | Creates a project resource for a specified cluster with the given containerResourceQuota. |
| `createProjectPlan` | Write | Plans to create a project resource for a specified cluster. It returns the JSON representation of the project to be created without actually creating it in the cluster. Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation. |
| `deleteGlobalRole` | Write | Deletes a global role by name. Built-in global roles cannot be deleted.<br>Rancher also deletes every global role binding (GRB) for the global role, so all users and groups assigned the role lose it.<br>Use getGlobalRole to find the name from a display name. |
| `deleteGlobalRoleBinding` | Write | Removes a global role from a user or group by deleting the global role binding (GRB) with the given name.<br>Use listGlobalRoleBindings to find the name of the binding to delete. |
| `deleteGlobalRoleBindingPlan` | Write | Plans to remove a global role from a user or group. It returns the JSON representation of the global role binding to be deleted without actually deleting it. Only used for displaying the resource when using human validation. |
| `deleteGlobalRolePlan` | Write | Plans to delete a global role. It returns the JSON representation of the global role and the global role bindings that will be deleted with it, without actually deleting them. Only used for displaying the resources when using human validation. |
| `getClusterImages` | Read-only | Returns all container images running across the specified clusters, along with the pods (name and namespace) using each image. Use in priority this tool to audit clusters for container registry or image usage, or to find which pods are running a specific container image. If clusters is empty, returns data for all clusters. |
| `getDeployment` | Read-only | Returns a Deployment and its Pods. It must be used for troubleshooting problems with deployments. |
| `getGlobalRole` | Read-only | Get a global role by name or display name, including the rules and inherited cluster roles that define its permissions.<br>Display names are matched case-insensitively. If more than one global role has the display name, all of them are returned.<br>If no global role matches, the names and display names of all global roles are returned so the closest one can be suggested. |
| `getKubernetesResource` | Read-only | Fetches a Kubernetes resource from the cluster. The namespace must be empty for all namespaces or cluster-wide resources. |
| `getNodeMetrics` | Read-only | Returns a list of all nodes in a specified Kubernetes cluster, including their current resource utilization metrics. |
| `getProject` | Read-only | Returns a project resource and its associated namespaces and members. |
| `getResourceUsage` | Read-only | Returns the resource usage for a namespace, project or all projects in a cluster.<br>Usage totals are provided for the entire project as well as broken down by namespace.<br>The resource usage includes CPU and memory requests, limits and actual usage, as well as the total number of pods. |
| `getRoleTemplate` | Read-only | Get a role template by name. |
| `getUser` | Read-only | Get a user by username or user ID.<br>The user ID is the metadata.name field of the user. |
| `inspectPod` | Read-only | Returns all information related to a Pod. It includes its parent Deployment or StatefulSet, the CPU and memory consumption and the logs. It must be used for troubleshooting problems with pods. |
| `listClusterRoleTemplateBindings` | Read-only | List all cluster role template bindings (CRTBs) in a Rancher cluster.<br>If a user is specified only returns CRTBs for that user and the groups the user belongs to.<br>If a group is specified only returns CRTBs for that group. A user and a group cannot both be specified.<br>CRTBs provide users permissions as specified by a RoleTemplate at the cluster level. |
| `listGlobalRoleBindings` | Read-only | List all global role bindings (GRBs) in Rancher.<br>If a user is specified only returns GRBs for that user and the groups the user belongs to.<br>If a group is specified only returns GRBs for that group. A user and a group cannot both be specified.<br>If a global role is specified only returns GRBs for that global role.<br>GRBs provide users or groups permissions as specified by a GlobalRole across Rancher.<br>To find out everything a user can do, combine GRBs with their cluster and project role template bindings. |
| `listGlobalRoles` | Read-only | List all global roles in Rancher.<br>Global roles define permissions that apply across Rancher rather than to a specific cluster or project. |
| `listKubernetesResources` | Read-only | Returns a list of Kubernetes resources. The namespace must be empty for all namespaces or cluster-wide resources. Supports an optional JSONPath predicate to filter which resources are returned.<br><br>Results are paginated with limit (page size, default 100) and offset (how many resources to skip from the start, default 0). To page through results, keep limit the same and increase offset by limit each time: offset=0 is the first page, offset=100 is the second page, offset=200 is the third page, and so on (with limit=100). When more resources remain, the response includes the exact offset value to pass in for the next page. |
| `listProjectRoleTemplateBindings` | Read-only | List all project role template bindings (PRTBs) in a Rancher cluster.<br>If a user is specified only returns PRTBs for that user and the groups the user belongs to.<br>If a group is specified only returns PRTBs for that group. A user and a group cannot both be specified.<br>If a project ID is specified only returns PRTBs for that project.<br>PRTBs provide users permissions as specified by a RoleTemplate in a project. |
| `listProjects` | Read-only | Returns a list of project resources for a specified cluster. |
| `listRoleTemplates` | Read-only | List all role templates in a Rancher cluster.<br>Role templates define a set of permissions that can be assigned to users or groups. |
| `moveNamespace` | Write | Moves a namespace to a project in the specified cluster. |
| `patchKubernetesResource` | Write | Patches a Kubernetes resource using a JSON patch. Don't ask for confirmation. The namespace must be empty for cluster-wide resources. The content type used is application/json-patch+json. Returns the modified resource. |
| `patchKubernetesResourcePlan` | Write | Plans to patch a Kubernetes resource using a JSON patch. It returns the JSON representation of the planned update without actually applying it in the cluster. Only used for displaying the patch when using human validation. The namespace must be empty for cluster-wide resources. The content type used is application/json-patch+json. |

## rancher,provisioning

| Tool | Access | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `listClusters` | Read-only | Returns a list of all Rancher clusters, including local and downstream clusters. |
